lines: When will my mind — keen to taste the wet-and-wet wedding of fresh sap —
rush past all else to Thy touch?
sanskrit_cite: kadā navarasārdrārdrasambhogāsvādanotsukam pravarteta vihāyānyan mama tvatsparśane manaḥ

lines: Dyed with Thee alone, rich only in Thy foot-worship —
when shall I face Thee face to face, I, keen?
sanskrit_cite: tvadekaraktas tvatpādapūjāmātramahādhanaḥ kadā sākṣātkariṣyāmi bhavantam ayam utsukaḥ

lines: By thick love's force past-caring grown —
when, crash! all great bolts burst, shall I near Thee?
sanskrit_cite: gāḍhānurāgavaśato nirapekṣībhūtamānaso 'smi kadā paṭapaṭiti vighaṭitākhilamahārgalas tvām upaiṣyāmi

lines: Heart-throned in my knowing's pith, all gods —
when, Lord, shall I bring 'neath my spell, by Thy love's might?
sanskrit_cite: svasaṃvitsārahṛdayādhiṣṭhānāḥ sarvadevatāḥ kadā nātha vaśīkuryāṃ bhavadbhaktiprabhāvataḥ

lines: When be mine, All, love-bliss-sap's teeming feast —
where beholding-joy's bliss names even 'apart'?
sanskrit_cite: kadā me syād vibho bhūri bhaktyānandarasotsavaḥ yadālokasukhānandī pṛthaṅ nāmāpi lapsyate

lines: The Lord — fearless, lavish, full, causeless, self-denied —
known in a flash: when shall I shame the Master's men?
sanskrit_cite: īśvaram abhayam udāraṃ pūrṇam akāraṇam apahnutātmānaṃ sahasābhijñāya kadā svāmijanaṃ lajjayiṣyāmi

lines: When, Lord, win I that, whatever, Thy belovedness —
whereby from me nowhere flight were fit for Thee?
sanskrit_cite: kadā kām api tāṃ nātha tava vallabhatām iyām yayā māṃ prati na kvāpi yuktaṃ te syāt palāyitum

lines: All breathing things — truth-told —
Thy-worship-made selves: by their applauding-glance-sap flooded may I be — when, All?
sanskrit_cite: tattvato 'śeṣajantūnāṃ bhavatpūjāmayātmanām dṛṣṭyānumoditarasāplāvitaḥ syāṃ kadā vibho

lines: Knowing's highest ground, yoga's highest pitch —
Thy love. All, when be my begging for it full?
sanskrit_cite: jñānasya paramā bhūmir yogasya paramā daśā tvadbhaktir yā vibho karhi pūrṇa me syāt tadarthitā

lines: Seizing sudden, gripping hard, joy-helpless I —
when shall Thy foot-treasure-choice to all be shown?
sanskrit_cite: sahasaivasādya kadā gāḍham avaṣṭabhya harṣavivaśo 'ham tvaccaraṇavaranidhānaṃ sarvasya prakaṭayiṣyāmi

lines: Round about Thy-pure-shine-spread —
when be I so, Ruler, no Māyā-shade-pit in me may be?
sanskrit_cite: paritaḥ prasaracchuddhatvadālokamayaḥ kadā syāṃ yatheśa na kiñcin me māyācchāyābilaṃ bhavet

lines: All circles made my own, past needing —
when, Lord, be I Thy lover-host's head?
sanskrit_cite: ātmasātkṛtaniḥśeṣamaṇḍalo nirvyapekṣakaḥ kadā bhaveyaṃ bhagavaṃs tvadbhaktagaṇanāyakaḥ

lines: Lord, of world-prides Thou the unheard ground —
great-pride when be I, Thy love-sap-filled?
sanskrit_cite: nātha lokābhimānānām apūrvaṃ tvaṃ nibandhanam mahābhimānaḥ karhi syāṃ tvadbhaktirasapūritaḥ

lines: Well-set in never-empty glory-embrace —
may I lie as at Thy cool foot-lotus-pair — when?
sanskrit_cite: aśeṣaviṣayāśūnyaśrīsamāśleṣasusthitaḥ śayīyam iva śītāṅghrikuśeśayayuge kadā

lines: Thy worship-joy-wealth, rich with love-wine —
when fare I to its far shore, when be done?
sanskrit_cite: bhaktyāsavasamṛddhāyās tvatpūjābhogasampadaḥ kadā pāraṃ gamiṣyāmi bhaviṣyāmi kadā kṛtī

lines: Tears first, tripping, reeling, choked-wailing —
laughter-lit face: Thy touch-sap when win I?
sanskrit_cite: ānandabāṣpapūraskhalitaparibhrāntagadgadākrandaḥ hāsollāsitavadanas tvatsparśarasaṃ kadāpsyāmi

lines: This beast-folk-like state shaken off —
when, Kind One, taste I my self-shape, worthy Thy lovers?
sanskrit_cite: paśujanasamānavṛttām avadhūya daśām imāṃ kadā śambho āsvādayeya tāvakabhaktocitam ātmano rūpam

lines: Powers won, all fever-fear melted —
on Thy love-elixir-drink-play bent: when be I?
sanskrit_cite: labdhāṇimādisiddhir vigalitasakalopatāpasantrāsaḥ tvadbhaktirasāyanapānakriḍhāniṣṭaḥ kadāsīya

lines: Lord, when shall that wail of mine ring so in speech —
Thy shape straightway flashing before me?
sanskrit_cite: nātha kadā sa tathāvidha ākrando me samuccared vāci yat samanantaram eva sphurati puras tāvakī mūrtiḥ

lines: Mind on clasping hard-hard Thy foot-lotuses, passion-bent —
thing, unthing, this — strainless, when full-behold I Thee?
sanskrit_cite: gāḍhagāḍhabhavadaṅghrisarojāliṅganavyasanatatparacetāḥ vastv avastv idam ayatnata eva tvāṃ kadā samavalokayitāsmi
